rubric.role_summary: Director-level manufacturing operations role scaling regulated cosmetic and medical-device products from R&D through commercial production, including CDMO partnerships, technology transfer, supply chain operations, and manufacturing financial planning.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Director-level manufacturing operations role scaling regulated cosmetic and medical-device products from R&D through commercial production, including CDMO partnerships, technology transfer, supply chain operations, and manufacturing financial planning.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience scaling a product from R&D to commercial manufacturing in a regulated environment.
- Experience overseeing manufacturing operations for a Class II or III medical device or equivalent regulated product.
- Experience managing supply chain operations.
- Familiarity with Quality Management Systems in regulated environments.
- Direct people management experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with combination products (drug + device), such as auto-injectors, EpiPens, nasal sprays, or microarray-based systems.
- Background in Material Science & Technology Transfer (MSNT).
- Experience scaling production to 100K+ units per month.
- Experience across both cosmetic and medical device products.
- Experience with automation and line redesign in a manufacturing scale-up context.
- Background in customer support or customer-facing operations within manufacturing.
- Experience managing managers or building multi-layered organizations.
- Experience implementing or optimizing operational infrastructure.
- Hands-on experience scaling production volumes significantly; 10x or more is an example, not a fixed threshold.
- Direct experience with CDMO partner selection, onboarding, and technology transfer.
- Experience managing supply chain, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment operations.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technology transfer and process scale-up.
- Experience with manufacturing cost modeling and financial planning.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
